title: Termwise additive equivalences for resolution cocycles
statement: For the displayed Zariski and étale injective resolutions and object, there exist the two additive equivalences appearing in the cocycle-homology comparison.

source.place: sites-cohomology.tex Section 01FT, equation-cohomology-object-site; derived.tex Tag 06XR (1), lemma-compute-ext-resolutions. The corresponding original .tex sections were fetched into the sandbox scratchpad and read.

proof.text: Evaluate objectCohomologyPresheaf_resolution at an object and turn its component isomorphism into an additive equivalence. Compose with AddEquiv.ulift on both sides to remove the universe lifts. Exact evaluation commutes with homology by ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso; compose with its inverse. This proves the private generic helper objectResolutionEquiv.

Apply objectResolutionEquiv to the supplied Zariski resolution R at V, obtaining e₁, and to the supplied étale resolution I at i(V), obtaining e₂. The étale evaluation complex is definitionally equal to the Zariski evaluation complex of the continuous pushforward, including its differentials. Return both equivalences with True.intro. The supplied comparison b imposes no condition on these equivalences.

theorem zariski_etale_resolution_cocycle_equivalences
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}}
    (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    (hi : i.IsContinuous (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
      X.smallEtaleTopology)
    [HasSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasExt
      (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasExt (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (R : InjectiveResolution ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).obj F))
    (b : R.cocomplex ⟶
      ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)
    (q : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) :
    ∃ (e₁ : Sheaf.H' ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).obj F) q V ≃+
        ↑(HomologicalComplex.homology
          (((sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
            (evaluation X.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op V)).mapHomologicalComplex
               (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj R.cocomplex) q))
      (e₂ : Sheaf.H' F q (i.obj V) ≃+
        ↑(HomologicalComplex.homology
          (((sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
            (evaluation X.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op V)).mapHomologicalComplex
               (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
                (((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
                  (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
                    X.smallEtaleTopology).mapHomologicalComplex
                       (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)) q)), True
